COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRJA No. 11 of 2025
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. R.K. Joshi, learned Brief Holder 
for the State of Uttarakhand. 
2. This is Jail Appeal against the 
conviction, received through Jailer,
District Jail, Haridwar. By the impugned 
judgment dated 22.01.2025, rendered by 
Additional Sessions Judge/F.T.S.C., 
District Haridwar in Special Sessions Trial 
No. 58 of 2021, the appellant was 
convicted for the offence punishable 
under Sections 376(2)(g), 376(3), 323 of 
the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and 5(l)/6 
of the Protection of Children from Sexual 
Offences Act, 2012 and was sentenced 
under Section 6 of the POCSO Act to 
undergo twenty years of rigorous 
imprisonment with a fine of Rs. 10,000/-. 
3. As per the office report, appeal is 
within time. 
4. Admit. 
5. Trial Court’s record be summoned.
6. List on 07.05.2025.
7. Mr. Bharat Singh, Advocate, is  appointed as Amicus Curiae to appear 
and argue on behalf of the appellant. 
8. Registry is directed to supply a copy 
of paper book to learned Amicus Curiae,
as and when the trial court’s record is 
received. 
(Ashish Naithani, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
28.02.2025
Shiksha
